cat > /etc/systemd/system/traffic-mirror.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Mirror node1<->node2 traffic on eth1 to node3
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/traffic-mirror.py 02:1d:d7:1b:94:b2 02:36:66:6a:17:21 02:b8:50:b7:5b:d8
Restart=always
RestartSec=2

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now traffic-mirror.service
sleep 1
systemctl is-active traffic-mirror.service
systemctl is-enabled traffic-mirror.service
